main_text.p: dum dato mihi , &c Imper. Hiph. pl. m. & f. m. & fæm. aff. Rad. שָׁקָה.
הַשְׁקוֹת bibendum dare, הַשְׁקֹתוֹ ei , &c. Infin. Hiph. aff. Rad. שָׁקָה.
לְהִשְׁתַּבֵּחַ ad gloriandum, לְהִשְׁתַּגֵּעַ ad insanien-dum, Infin. Hithp. R. שָׁבַח, & שָׁגַע.

הִשְׁתַּחְוָה incurvavit se, הִשְׁתַּחְווּ incurvarunt se, הִשְׁתַּחְוִיתָ incurvasti te, &c. præt. Hithp. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. ut & 2. f. m. item, הִשְׁתַּחֲוֵה incurva te, Imper. Hithp. & הִשְׁתַּחָוֹת incurvare se, Infin. Hithp. Rad. שָׁחָה.
וְהִשְׁתַּנִּית & mutabis te, præt. Hithp. 2. f. fæm. Rad. שָׁנָה.
הִשְׁתָּעָה obstupescit, præt. Hithp. 3. f. m. & ex forma Piel quadratæ, הִשְׁתַּעְשְׁעוּ [?] oblectant se, præt. Hithp. 3. pl. R.
בְּהִשְׁתַּפֵּךְ in effundere te, מֵהִשְׁתָּרֵעַ [?] à redundando, Infin. Hithp. præf. Rad. שָׁפַךְ, & שָׁרַע.
הִשְׁתָּרֵר principatum sumendo, Infin. Hithp. Rad. שָׁרַר.
הִתְאַוִּיתִי concupivi, præt. Hithp. 1. f. R. אָוָה.
הִתְאַוִּיתֶם vos concupistis, præt. Hithp. 2. pl. m. Rad. אָוָה.
הִתְאַשְּׁשׁוּ, vel fortes estote, Imper. Hithp. pl. m. R. אָשַׁשׁ, vel à No. Rad. אִישׁ.
הִתְבּוֹנַנְתָּ intelligit, consideràsti, præt. Hithp. 3. & 2. f. m. R. בִּין.
הִתְגַּדְּלְתִּי magnificavi me, pro הִ præt. Hithp. 1. f. R. גָּדַל Ezech. 38. 23.
לְהִתְגּוֹלֵל ad devolvendum se, Inf. Hithp. & הִתְגּוֹלְּלוּ de-

page.notes: Hebrew words are copied from the scan as best I can read them; those marked [?] are doubtful. Italic Latin glosses are set in italics as printed. The right column ends with the hyphenated word "de-", which continues on the next page. The printed "s" forms in "consideràsti" and "obstupescit" have been written as plain s; the accent in "consideràsti" is a printed mark, kept as it appears. The centred "ה ת" is a section letter, given as a paragraph, not a heading.
